verdict.rationale: Luma documents an official API with Python/JS/TS SDKs covering core generation: text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video with character references and keyframes, Draft Mode, and HDR/EXR output. That overlaps substantially with the Ray UI feature set. However, nothing states UI–API parity, the API is described as just two endpoints, and many UI features (Modify Video V2, Reframe, motion/expression transfer, lighting changes, 16-keyframe Multi-Keyframe, Agents, Skills) are not shown to be API-accessible. No OpenAPI spec was found by probe. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API coverage of Modify/Reframe/motion transfer/Skills/Agents, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API breadth.
